=== T9 ===
title: Jacobian⇄Albanese endgame glue
obj: If representability is not yet proven, don't try to fill its sorries, this is another task, just work on the albanese part. For a smooth proper geometrically irreducible curve $C/k$ with $k$-rational point, the Jacobian $J = \mathrm{Pic}^{0}_{C/k}$ satisfies the Albanese universal property $$\forall\, (A,a)\ \text{pointed abelian variety},\quad \mathrm{Hom}_{\ast}(C,A)\ \xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\ \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathrm{AbVar}}(J,A),$$ and is the unique such object up to canonical isomorphism.  You may read the Albanese subproject to see whether there has already been progress not updated with this project.

title: Codim-one rational-map extension (ALB.codim1)
obj: Prove the codimension-one extension of rational maps into an abelian variety (Weil / Hartshorne condition $(\ast)$): a rational map $f\colon C \dashrightarrow A$ from a smooth curve to an abelian variety is defined in codimension one, hence $$f\ \text{extends to a morphism}\ C \to A\quad(\text{the locus of indeterminacy has codim} \ge 2 = \varnothing\ \text{on a curve}).$$
